title.narrative: New European Support Programme for Refugees, Migrants and Host Communities in Colombia, Ecuador and Peru

description.narrative: The action aims to respond to the continued critical situation caused by the massive flow of migrants and refugees from Venezuela. Support will be provided to Colombia, Ecuador and Peru.The specific objectives (outcomes) of the Action are:Outcome 1 (R1: Regularization of Migratory Status): refugees and migrants from Venezuela can exercise their rights and have access to a regular migration and asylum status (COL-ECU-PER) in coordination with regional efforts (cf. Quito process).Outcome 2Outcome 2 (R2: Socio-economic integration): Venezuelan refugees and migrants, especially women and vulnerable persons from host communities, obtain access to social and economic integration in COL, ECU and PER. Outcome 3 (R3: Protection of vulnerable refugees and migrants): Protection and prevention measures are put in place for the most vulnerable refugees and migrants, such as (potential) victims of GBV, violence against girls and boys, victims of human trafficking and smuggling, sexual and labour exploitation.Outcome 4 (R4: Reduction of xenophobia and discrimination): Measures to combat xenophobia and discrimination against refugees and migrants and to foster peaceful coexistence reach the population of critical territories in the three countries.

description.narrative: The refugees and migrants from Venezuela can exercise their rights and have access to a regular migration or asylum status (COLECUPER) in coordination with regional efforts (cf. Quito process).

title.narrative: 1.3 Migracin Colombia Pilot

description.narrative: Only Colombia:Within the framework of a Migracin Colombia manufacturing and distribution pilot, 20,000 Venezuelan migrants (of which at least 50% women) have received their TPP (Temporary Protection Permit) ID card.
